# Blender body path (docs/vehicle-format.md, body.glb): the test vehicle tests/data/vehicles/suv_glb_test (the
# SUV with the body generated by tools/cars/blender, the SUV's olive paint from vehicle.json) with procedural wheels and suspension:
#   ./build/release/trailforge --script tools/scenarios/vehicle_glb.txt
# Run from the repository root (the vehicle file path is relative). Views at rest, articulation on the twister,
# lamps at night, then the shipped procedural SUV for comparison. Captures /tmp/trailforge_vglb_*.png.
set ui 0
set hud 0
set auto_reverse 0
quality High
time Noon
teleport 0
wait 1.0
vehicle_file tests/data/vehicles/suv_glb_test/vehicle.json
wait 2.5
expect body_glb == 1
expect body_parts == 42
expect body_hulls == 7
expect body_triangles < 10000
expect speed_kmh < 0.5
set grass 0
camera vehicle side 9 40
wait 0.4
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_side.png
wait 0.3
camera vehicle front 8 40
wait 0.4
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_front.png
wait 0.3
camera vehicle three_quarter 8 45
wait 0.4
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_34.png
wait 0.3
camera vehicle three_quarter_rear 8 45
wait 0.4
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_34rear.png
wait 0.3
camera vehicle top 18 20
wait 0.4
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_top.png
wait 0.3
# Twister: the procedural wheels and suspension articulate inside the body's arches.
set grass 1
teleport 2
wait 2.0
expect body_glb == 1
tap L
wait 0.3
down W
until z > -1.5 20
up W
down S
wait 2.5
expect susp_spread > 0.20
camera 0.6 1.1 -5.2 -0.2 0.6 1.2
wait 0.5
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_twister_rear.png
wait 0.3
camera 6.4 1.0 1.2 -0.2 0.5 1.2
wait 0.5
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_twister_left.png
wait 0.3
camera -6.8 1.0 1.2 -0.2 0.5 1.2
wait 0.5
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_twister_right.png
up S
wait 0.3
# Night: head lamps on, brake lamps lit by the pedal.
time Night
teleport 0
wait 2.0
set headlights 1
down S
wait 0.5
camera vehicle three_quarter 8 45
wait 0.6
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_night_front.png
wait 0.3
camera vehicle three_quarter_rear 8 45
wait 0.6
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_night_rear.png
up S
wait 0.3
# The shipped SUV keeps its procedural body.
time Noon
set headlights 0
vehicle trailforge_suv
wait 2.5
expect body_glb == 0
expect body_triangles > 15000          # kit body ~17.9k (the glb test body has < 10000)
camera vehicle three_quarter 8 45
wait 0.4
capture /tmp/trailforge_vglb_procedural_34.png
quit
